records.question: Nicki spent the last year running a lot. For the first half of the year, she ran a total of 20 miles per week. For the second half of the year, she increased the mileage to 30 miles per week. How many miles total did she run for the year?
records.response:
There are 52 weeks in a year, so the first half of the year is 26 weeks.
For the first half of the year, Nicki ran 20 miles per week, so she ran a total of 20*26 = 520 miles.
For the second half of the year, Nicki ran 30 miles per week, so she ran a total of 30*26 = 780 miles.
In total, Nicki ran 520 + 780 = 1300 miles for the year.
#### 1300
